City & Us privacy

Local source testing build · 13 November 2026

Normal gameplay checks this game's Supabase service connection. Account stories save locally immediately and sync automatically while signed in. Isolated review saves do not contact account or chat services. There is no advertising, analytics or microphone recording.

Supabase processes your email, sign-in details and sessions. Google sign-in opens in your browser; Google and Supabase handle that authentication. Session credentials persist in this app/browser's local storage until sign-out or erasure. Do not use a shared device without signing out.

Account saves contain your character name, local story ID, appearance, inventory, money, progression and preferences. Guest and account stories remain separate. Conflicting copies are retained locally for recovery. Gallery photos/videos stay in device IndexedDB and are excluded from account snapshots. Exported files remain wherever you save them.

Chat stores your separate public Player ID and chosen display name, private conversation membership, messages, timestamps, receipt acknowledgements, block/mute settings and reports. Player lookup returns public identity and display name only, never email or backups. Participants can read their conversations. Reports and deletion requests are restricted to the project owner/server service role for moderation and support.

Sent confirms server storage; delivered confirms a recipient client acknowledged the message; read confirms the message was displayed in its visible conversation. These are client acknowledgements, not proof a person understood the content.

Signing out retains local stories and pending changes, isolated by account. Account deletion removes the verified account and its linked profile, online save, sent messages and reports involving that account. The other participant's own messages remain. The current device removes only that account's local story, recovery, sync queue and message outbox. Guest saves, unrelated accounts, gallery media, other devices and exported files require separate erasure. Clear app/site data to remove all local data.

Delete your account or submit a deletion request. Requests stay pending until the project owner acts; a submitted request is not completed deletion. Password recovery is available on that page without gameplay.

Hosts and Supabase may log service requests. Diagnostics remain on-device unless you copy/share them. Cloud snapshots remain client-authored solo progress; online play does not establish authoritative money, ownership or permissions.

The Android source now requests internet access and supports external-browser authentication, but no APK has been rebuilt. Live backend deployment, OAuth/email setup, device verification and a designated moderation/deletion operator remain pending. Owner contact details and a public policy URL must be supplied before store submission.
